lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are distributed across the mid-lateral flank, with the inter-cluster distance increasing along the anterior-to-posterior axis (right to left).
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular clusters, forming a grid-like pattern particularly visible in the central portion of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-luminance, elongated rectangular artifact is attached to the body at the posterior base of the visible lower-most fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct transition in patterning occurs at the right edge of the frame, where pixel clusters shift from a sparse, large-diameter grid to a high-density, small-diameter configuration.
